#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define F(i,j,n) for(int i=j;i<=n;i++)
#define D(i,j,n) for(int i=j;i>=n;i--)
#define ll unsigned long long
#define N 250010
using namespace std;
namespace io{
	const int L=(1<<19)+1;
	char ibuf[L],*iS,*iT,obuf[L],*oS=obuf,*oT=obuf+L-1,c,st[55];int f,tp;
	char gc(){
		if(iS==iT){
			iT=(iS=ibuf)+fread(ibuf,1,L,stdin);
			return iS==iT?EOF:*iS++;
		}
		return*iS++;
	}
	template<class I>void gi(I&x){
		for(f=1,c=gc();c<'0'||c>'9';c=gc())if(c=='-')f=-1;
		for(x=0;c<='9'&&c>='0';c=gc())x=x*10+(c&15);x*=f;
	}
};
using io::gi;
using io::gc;
int n,k,p,l,b[N];
ll x[26][N],f[N],g[N],a,d;
ll pw(ll x,int y=2147483642){ll a=1;while(y){if(y&1)a=a*x%p;x=x*x%p;y>>=1;}return a;}
ll dfs(int k,int n){
	if(b[n]<k)return 0;
	if(k==1)return x[k][n]=g[n];
	if(x[k][n])return x[k][n];
	int t=0; 
	for(int i=n&(n-1);i;i=n&(i-1))if(b[i]>=k-1){
		x[k][n]+=dfs(k-1,i)*g[n^i];
		if(++t==18)t=0,x[k][n]%=p;
	}
	x[k][n]%=p; 
//	printf("%d %d %lld\n",k,n,x[k][n]);
	return x[k][n];
}
ll c(int n,int m){return f[n]*g[m]%p*g[n-m]%p;}
int main()
{
	#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("255x.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("255x.out","w",stdout);
	#endif
	gi(n);gi(k);gi(p);
	F(i,1,n)b[i]=b[i>>1]+(i&1); 
	a=pw(k,n);
	if(n&1){printf("%d\n",a);return 0;}
	l=min(k,b[n]);
	f[0]=1;F(i,1,n)f[i]=f[i-1]*i%p;
	g[n]=pw(f[n]);D(i,n,1)g[i-1]=g[i]*i%p;
	D(i,l,1)d+=c(k,i)*dfs(i,n);
//	cout<<a<<endl<<d<<endl; 
	a=(a-d%p*f[n]%p+p)%p;
	printf("%lld\n",a);
//	printf("%.3lf\n",(double)clock()/CLOCKS_PER_SEC);
	return 0;
}
